relationships.kurono-shinguji: Relies on her to stall Enterprise and recognizes the danger of her Three Thousand Worlds overuse.

periods.summary: With Tsukikage missing, Itsuki commands the Tokyo defense from the underground operations center. He explains that Tsukikage has returned to Tsushima, anticipates a second US attack, and mobilizes every available knight. When EDY breaks into the underground city, he makes the severe decision to deploy D- and E-rank student knights to the defense layer, accepting responsibility for the risks. After reinforcements turn the battle, he commits reserves, stops unnecessary pursuit, creates an emergency hospital with Iron Blood Alchemy, and personally announces Japan's victory to the exhausted defenders.

key_events.summary: Commands defenses and sends low-rank students into the underground defense layer.
Commits remaining forces, stops pursuit and announces victory.
